suggestions.title: Increase Instagram posting frequency and optimize posting times
suggestions.problem: Instagram reach is critically low (2 people today), indicating minimal content distribution or posting activity
suggestions.root_cause: Likely infrequent posting schedule or posts published during off-peak hours when the target audience (bakery/cafe enthusiasts) are less active. Instagram's algorithm deprioritizes accounts with inconsistent posting patterns.
suggestions.suggestion: Establish a consistent posting schedule of 4-5 posts per week, specifically targeting 7-9 AM and 12-1 PM JST (peak cafe/bakery discovery times). Use Instagram's scheduling feature to maintain consistency. Include location tags and bakery-specific hashtags (#パン屋 #カフェ #新作スイーツ) in every post.
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase daily reach from 2 to 50-100+ by improving algorithmic distribution and catching users during peak discovery hours
suggestions.implementation_note: Create a content calendar with posts on Mon/Wed/Fri/Sat/Sun. Example: Monday 8 AM (new bakery feature), Wednesday 1 PM (bakery interview), Friday 7 AM (weekend recommendations), Sunday 12 PM (week preview). Track which times generate highest engagement and adjust accordingly.

suggestions.title: Reduce bounce rate by improving website landing page relevance
suggestions.problem: Engagement rate is low (44% of sessions are engaged) with recent trend deterioration (0 engaged sessions on 20260821). Website traffic shows 2-9 sessions daily but only 44-56% result in meaningful engagement.
suggestions.root_cause: Users arriving at the website from Instagram or search may not find the content they're looking for immediately. Homepage might lack clear value proposition or navigation, causing users to leave without exploring bakery listings.
suggestions.suggestion: Create a dedicated landing page for Instagram traffic that immediately showcases: (1) Top-rated bakeries near user's location, (2) New bakery additions this week, (3) Clear search/filter functionality. Add a sticky header with prominent search bar and category filters (by region, bakery type, specialty). Implement breadcrumb navigation for better UX.
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase engaged sessions ratio from 44% to 65-70%, meaning more visitors explore bakery listings. With 9 daily sessions, this could increase engaged sessions from 4 to 6 per day.
suggestions.implementation_note: Example landing page structure: ```<header sticky><SearchBar placeholder='地域名で検索' /></header><section><PopularBakeries /></section><section><NewAdditions /></section><section><RegionFilter /></section>``` Track which content sections receive most clicks and double down on high-performing categories.

suggestions.title: Create Instagram content that drives website traffic through clear CTAs
suggestions.problem: Instagram reach is minimal (2 today) and there's no visible connection between Instagram activity and website sessions. The 2-9 daily website sessions don't correlate with Instagram posting patterns.
suggestions.root_cause: Instagram posts likely lack clear calls-to-action (CTAs) directing followers to the website, or posts don't include direct links/QR codes. Followers may see content but not know how to visit the website to explore bakeries.
suggestions.suggestion: Every Instagram post should include: (1) A dedicated link in bio pointing to featured bakery or 'new bakeries this week' page, (2) '詳細はプロフのリンクから' CTA in caption, (3) QR code linking to specific bakery pages, (4) Swipe-up sticker if account has 10k+ followers. Test using URL shorteners (bit.ly) to track click-through rate for each post.
suggestions.expected_impact: Drive 5-10 direct visits per Instagram post to the website, increasing daily sessions from 5-9 to 12-18. If Instagram posts reach 50-100 people with 5-10% CTR, expect 2-5 new sessions per post.
suggestions.implementation_note: Example caption format: '🍞 新潟県燕三条の話題のパン屋さんをご紹介! 🎯 詳細はプロフのリンクから👆 #パン屋 #新潟グルメ'. Create short URLs: `chirumaru.jp/bakery/new-week` for tracking. Monitor UTM parameters: `?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=bio&utm_campaign=bakery-feature` to measure conversion.
